chief_complaint: Post-meal abdominal burning and gas, sometimes rising to the chest.
history_of_present_illness: Burning for 4–5 days, worse after meals, especially spicy or oily food, with frequent burping. No vomiting, diarrhea, or weight loss. Reports work stress and late sleep.

medicines.name: Pantoprazole
medicines.frequency: Every morning on an empty stomach

advice: Avoid spicy and oily food, reduce tea and coffee, and avoid late-night meals.
follow_up: Report back after the 14-day course; improvement is expected in 5–7 days if lifestyle advice is followed.
